title: Beam and plate modal analysis vs closed-form eigenfrequencies (L3 rung)

gates.quantity: worst relative error of beam modes 1-5 (N=40)
worst relative error of plate modes (1,1)..(2,2) (N=40)
minimum observed order over the five beam mode errors
minimum observed order over the plate mode errors
beam frequency errors decrease monotonically with refinement
plate frequency errors decrease monotonically with refinement

limitations: Euler-Bernoulli beam (no rotary inertia, no shear): the L/h = 80 beam is slender enough for the first five modes, but mode 5 of a stubby beam would need Timoshenko kinematics.
Kirchhoff plate: a/t = 100 puts the Mindlin shear correction at ~1e-4 relative, below the 3 % gate but not modelled here.
Simply supported edges only -- clamped and free plate modes are not covered by this rung (the CCCC static case is in benchmarks/verified/fem_plate_static).
FE consistent-mass models are stiffer in frequency than the exact spectrum only in the limit h -> 0; the observed errors approach zero from above, which the monotonicity gate records.
